name: Thit de nui
summary: Mountain goat eaten at Tam Coc and in Ninh Bình, from goats left on the hills rather than penned. DulichToday, updated 25 January 2024, lists the table herbs as chanh, gừng, ớt, sả, riềng, lá sung, lá mơ, and green banana. The 20 October 2023 culture office describes the same herding and places the cooking with người Hoa Lư and the city or the old capital. Both placements stay.
origin: Restaurants at Tam Coc, and also the city or the old capital on the culture office note.
howToEat: Eat it with chanh, gừng, ớt, sả, riềng, lá sung, lá mơ, and green banana, as DulichToday lists them for the Tam Coc table.
Order it with cơm cháy on that Tam Coc restaurant sentence. A meal hour is Check on arrival.
where: Restaurants at Tam Coc, with no street named. The culture office still places the cooking in the city or the old capital.
seoTitle: Thit de nui — Tam Coc mountain goat
seoDescription: Mountain goat at Tam Coc restaurants, herbs listed by DulichToday, and the same herding placed in the city or the old capital by the culture office.
